note: 25 distinct original enemy animation briefs, not finished art, 3D rigs, verified counterpart comparisons or deployed gameplay. Implement and validate individually.

rules.stageDifficulty: increase health, reaction complexity and attack telegraphs with stage; add genuinely new variants only after art approval
rules.motion: anticipation, acceleration, contact, follow-through, recovery, grounded foot placement, readable telegraph
rules.accessibility: respect reduced-motion and avoid flash-heavy effects
rules.performance: mobile-first; capped particles; reuse rig mechanics but never repeat visual identity
